sourceInformation.source: Quest for the Rings (1981), Magnavox / Philips
sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed three-quarter ground view, shared camera
sourceInformation.tech: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, my-3D2dge v0.89.1 at 8ecc2f62353761187bdfe226f327b7ea5d2eb691; AI Hub Session Protocol v1, client 1.4.0 at 35a1047f2067b2af3de3943f0fe452f39105d869
sourceInformation.artDirection: Native procedural shaded pixel art; gold and obsidian, luminous crystal, pale furnace stone, violet machinery; original heroes, dragon, seals and castle tokens
sourceInformation.animation: Native Humanoid skeletons, Attack timelines and custom continuous poses; procedural dragon and Nightmare rigs
sourceInformation.audio: Code-only Web Audio music, sound effects and gibberish voices. Independent master/music/effects/voice controls. Default music 10%. Original game continuous music and exact timbres unknown.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub shared-world authoritative 1–2-player co-op, including server-only host; standalone solo companion and couch co-op. No standalone online matchmaking.
sourceInformation.testing: Deterministic 120 Hz simulation; 40 ordinary extraction scenarios covering all ten pairs across four families at maximum Dread; normal complete campaign in simulation and final HTML; Chromium UI/controller/multitouch stand-ins; WebKit/Firefox native rendering; OfflineAudioContext signal checks; native asset sheets; AI Hub standard/lossy/departure/server/one-player conformance and shared gameplay. Physical devices, human listeners and human timing unavailable.
sourceInformation.research: Original manual transcript and scanned cover, hero illustrations and dungeon gameplay page; pinned full engine README, API card, asset guide and adventure kit; pinned Hub README, client and harness.
sourceInformation.environment: Codex CLI (headless); Linux, Ubuntu on WSL2

testingFeedback: 25 game findings from automated tests and visual/code review were repaired; test-fixture and tool-configuration mistakes are excluded.
2 critical findings: Escape could strand the title, and malformed checkpoint metadata could break Continue or later completion. Both are fixed and covered by regressions.
The ordinary-action complete expedition through the bundled HTML, independently checking all eight rooms, four recovered rings, four bindings, victory and replay.
Static reachability alone: useful for authoring, but unable to establish that a hero can execute the route or finish an extraction.
engineFeedback: Native shaded Humanoid rigs, continuous Attack poses and material-defined objects give code-created art a consistent identity.

aiHub.name: Much Ado About Rings
aiHub.tagline: Two heroes. Four rings. One way out.
aiHub.description: Steal four rings from the Ringmaster’s changing labyrinths, then bind a deathless dragon and escape together. Play solo with a companion, couch co-op, or online shared-world co-op inside AI Hub.
aiHub.controls: WASD / left stick move; mouse / right stick aim; click / R2 primary; right click / L2 power; Space / Cross evade; E / Triangle interact; Q / R1 companion; Tab / Square map; Escape / Options menu. Spare controller joins couch co-op; AI Hub supplies online play.
